grupos.descricao: A Data Model for camera installations in a city. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

An apparatus (hardware + software + firmware) intended to accomplish a particular task (sensing the environment, actuating, etc.). Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons, Device-Commons.
Description of a generic measurement entity coming from a device or other data source. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

grupos.nome: Smart Data Models - Device Model schema
grupos.descricao: This entity captures the static properties of a Device. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, PhysicalObject-Commons, Device-Commons.

This entity contains a harmonised description of a generic device operation entity. The device operation entity contains dynamic data reported by a device and is therefore applicable to all IoT segments and related IoT applications. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

grupos.nome: Smart Data models - ModBus data model
grupos.descricao: This entity contains a harmonised description of a modbus payload adapted from the modbus application protocol v1.1.b3 Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

grupos.nome: Smart Data Models - Polar H10 ACC Topic
grupos.descricao: A Data Model of Polar H10 Heart Rate Sensor with RR, HRV, HR, and ECG Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.
Information about privacy for an IoT device Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.
Data model for Sense Hat sensor readings for an array of sensing capabilities for Raspberry Pi. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

grupos.nome: Smart Data Models - Smart Metering Observation
grupos.descricao: This entity contains a harmonised description of a Smart Meter Observation, generally applicable for Smart Homes, Industry, Cities and Agriculture. It is based mostly in the GSMA entity definition but it is extended Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

Data model for the Ultra Wideband (UWB) Anchor which are electronic devices that detect UWB pulses emitted by UWB Tags and forward them to the location server for calculating tag positions. Inclui as definições comuns: GSMA-Commons, Location-Commons.

Sensor: A device that detects and responds to events or changes in the physical environment such as light, motion, or temperature changes. https://w3id.org/saref#Sensor. actuator : A device responsible for moving or controlling a mechanism or system. https://w3id.org/saref#Actuator. Meter : A device built to accurately detect and display a quantity in a form readable by a human being. Partially defined by SAREF. HVAC : Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) device that provides indoor environmental comfort. https://w3id.org/saref#HVAC. Network : A device used to connect other devices in a network, such as hub, switch or router in a LAN or Sensor network. (https://w3id.org/saref#Network. Multimedia : A device designed to display, store, record or play multimedia content such as audio, images, animation, video. Raw category will be deprecated use deviceCategory instead to avoid conflict with other aqttributes named category
